families.defect1: CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP. In all four cr-400-filled.pdf fixtures the Judicial Council footer is damaged and runs off the left page edge. The official CR-400 and the committed derived-sources/cr-400-pikepdf-unlocked.pdf both render it intact over two lines from x=36.00 with no word outside the page box (432 words each, minimum x0 = 36.00). The filled artifact re-flows it onto one line at y=766.0, drops the words "For" and "your", truncates "protection" to "otection", and places it at x0 = -3.485, i.e. 3.49pt off the page. A word-set diff confirms "For" and "protection" present in the official and absent from the filled artifact, "otection" present in the filled artifact and absent from the official. The mechanism is recorded in the family’s own reports/actual-writes.json pdfLibWarnings: "Removing XFA form data as pdf-lib does not support reading or writing XFA" — the XFA-to-flattened-AcroForm conversion is re-laying out official furniture. reports/source-fidelity.json cannot catch it because it compares official-to-derived only (which is faithful) and never derived-to-filled. The visualDefects counter reports 0 and does not see it.
families.defect1RepairTarget: the CR-400 finalize/flatten path, and extending the source-fidelity acceptance check to cover the filled artifact rather than stopping at the derived one
families.defect2: SERVICE. packet-family-build-worklist.json records serviceRecipients as "recorded": "Serve the prosecuting agency and file CR-401 proof of service.", and certificateOfService as "recorded": "proof_of_service: CR-401"; CA.memo.json rules.service says the same. participant-instructions.md instead tells the participant that "who must be served and by what method ... are not established in this repository." The method half is true (serviceMethod and serviceTiming are both not_recorded); the "who" half is false against a held record, and the packet ships CR-401 with a 25-row blank table while never saying whom it proves service on. This is amendment A1’s defect one obligation over.

families.nearMissRecorded: FEE_AND_WAIVER was very nearly failed on the same reasoning, because CA.memo.json holds "FW-001 is the general California fee waiver form." Reading WAVE_2_LEGAL_INPUT_ASSIGNMENTS.json first showed that point already adjudicated for this exact family: FW-001 is named "only as California’s general fee-waiver form, which does not determine whether either §11361.8 filing has a fee or when a waiver is required. That exact legal input is absent." The worklist records filingFee as not_recorded. The packet therefore correctly states that neither is established and names the clerk of the Superior Court in the county of the conviction, which is the determination’s third met-branch. Scored PASS. Recording the near miss because demanding a figure the repository does not hold is precisely the invention the determination forbids.

families.defect1: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING. Three defects, all participant-facing, all still present. Mis-mapped labels: Town_Court_Specify carries "Village Court, Village o" (the town-court blank with the village-court caption — the form’s face prints both as distinct controls); CJTN_Unknown carries "NYSID/New York State Identification N", the wrong tracking number entirely; Docket_Case_Number_Unknown carries "______________________________", which is not a label. A mojibake label: File_Copy’s label is undecoded subsetted-font bytes delivered verbatim to the participant. Court-only fields surfaced as participant obligations: Application_Complete, File_Copy and Copies_Sent are items 1, 4 and 5 of the checklist the form prints under "***FOR COURT USE ONLY – DO NOT WRITE BELOW THIS LINE***", read off the form’s own face here; all three carry requiredBeforeFiling true and are listed under "Exact facts still required before filing" while the same file’s last line says every control below that line stays blank. The file contradicts itself and, at face value, directs the participant to write where the form forbids it. Their siblings Proper_ID, Charge_Sealed and Comment_Entered are refused without that flag, so the treatment is not internally consistent either. A further off-by-one: File_Copy carries item 4’s text and Copies_Sent item 5’s, while their names correspond to items 5 and 6.
families.defect2: FILING_DESTINATION. The form’s own printed instruction, extracted from the fixture bytes here, reads "Submit your application to the Court where you were convicted." The worklist records filingDestination as "recorded". The packet says "Confirm current revision, filing destination, local procedures, fees, attachments, service, and proposed-order requirements before filing." Amendment A1 exactly.
families.defect3: FEE_AND_WAIVER. The form’s printed instruction 1 states on its own face "(NOTE: There is no application fee.)" and the worklist records filingFee as "recorded". The packet’s only cost sentence is the same catch-all, which is the determination’s second notMet branch — a gesture at a fee without naming who answers it.
families.defect4: SERVICE. The worklist records serviceRecipients, serviceMethod, certificateOfService and notice all as not_recorded, so no held source establishes a service rule and a NAMED authority could have stood in. The packet names none — only "Complete service certificates only after service actually occurs" and the catch-all. No office, no desk, no clerk. True silence fails. Item 6 of the form’s court-use-only checklist reads "Copies of application sent to prosecutor, law enforcement agencies and DCJS as applicable for further processing", so the court distributes and the participant plausibly serves nobody; the packet could state that affirmatively with the mechanism that replaces service.
families.allFourShareOneRoot: defects 2, 3 and 4 are the same single catch-all sentence in participant-instructions.md doing the work of three answers the packet either holds or could name. Repairing that one sentence, plus the field-map labelling and the requiredBeforeFiling flags on the three court-only controls, closes all four.

The ND memo’s nd-nonconviction-close-petition track does state there is no filing fee under § 12-60.1-05(4), but that is a different instrument on a different branch — the pre-2025 petition the receipt expressly separates and does not carry — and the auto-close track’s own "fees: none" belongs to the automatic parent where nothing is filed at all.
